failure_type: wind / gusts + late detection (short sensing range) + sensor noise
explanation: The UAV collided with an obstacle at 4.0 seconds due to a combination of environmental and sensing limitations. The flight failure was confirmed to be prevented by removing wind and gusts (max 7.3 m/s felt), increasing the 6.3 m sensing range, or eliminating the 0.4 m sensor noise standard deviation.
